A tiny cream corner inset may show the same fridge silhouette with its BACK highlighted, matching the original's small orientation inset. No other text. Visually tell the story: cool vapor enters pump, becomes hot high-pressure gas, gives heat to the room through the external coil, leaves as a liquid.
